conclusion: No concrete defect found in the pinned bounded utility. Integration and final context/QA acceptance remain separate requirements.
verified_invariants: Only split values change; all other columns and input DataFrame remain preserved.
Only whole existing leakage groups from train or weak_validation can move; any active/protected or active/active cross-boundary group is rejected.
Gold/quarantine target values do not contribute candidate classes, ranking or coverage.
Candidates are evaluated using already-fixed mask==1 weak labels only.
Each donor retains every previously present target/class, and the recipient gains a previously missing pair.
Global missing split/class count strictly decreases. Global class absence fails before moves.
Candidate ordering is group study count, SHA256(existing group ID), then group ID, with fixed canonical missing-pair order.
No safe donor fails closed; this is a conservative deterministic greedy repair, not a claim that every mathematically possible partition is found.
Exact moved groups, UIDs, directions, before/after counts and rule version are serialized by separate audit.
move_bound_analysis: Although MAX_MOVES is48, global presence guarantees at least24 of48 split/class pairs initially present. Strict monotonic improvement therefore needs at most24 actual moves. The independent worst-case fixture performs exactly24 safe moves and terminates complete.

independent_tests.cases: One exact24-move fixture plus20 randomized fixtures checking complete coverage, whole-group preservation, protected values, row-order independence and unchanged clinical/mask fields.
independent_tests.scope: Entirely synthetic utility-level tests; no real gold or clinical values inspected.

integration_requirements: Add utility and exact rule version to accepted data-semantic code/split-policy context.
Apply the same utility after fixed semantic/technical masking in both labels export and deterministic fresh release replay.
Do not select or alter holds based on class counts or gold values.
Recompute final complete release table/receipt and before/after split proof after actual fixed membership; retain original hash-based splits as historical before evidence.
